description: Rewrites a CV for a specific job spec using NextRole's multi-pass tailor→critic engine. The result lists any date or figure the draft states that the source CV does not; correct those before use. Free anonymous allowance; on exhaustion returns a link to continue on the web app.

cv_markdown.description: The CV in Markdown. On a signed-in connection, omit it to tailor from your saved master CV.

name: tailor_cv_to_role
title: Tailor a CV to a job
